resources.string: 1. Make sure the service status above is \"Running\"
2. Take a screenshot on the bill detail page in Alipay or other apps
3. The app will automatically recognize bill amounts and items
4. Confirm the information and save the accounting record
1. Fully offline: recognition and translation happen on your phone — nothing is uploaded and no network is needed.
2. Text recognition (OCR): uses the PP-OCRv6 AI model to read text from your screenshot.
3. It extracts the amount, merchant, time and other details for you.
4. It suggests the bill category based on the merchant and items.
5. Offline translation: Chinese-English translation of category names uses the OPUS-MT (Marian) AI model on your device.
Storage permission is needed to read screenshot images. Please grant the permission to enable screenshot monitoring.
Notification permission is needed to show screenshot monitoring status. Please grant the notification permission.
Full-screen notification permission is needed to automatically show the confirmation screen after taking a screenshot (Android 14+). Please enable it in settings.
Automatically show confirmation screen after screenshot recognition
